edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. The proposed purchase price for the Shares is USD 45,000,000, subject to customary adjustments for cash, indebtedness, unpaid transaction expenses and the difference between closing working capital and an agreed normalized working-capital target. The definitive agreement shall specify the relevant definitions, accounting principles, illustrative calculation, estimated closing statement, post-closing true-up and independent accountant dispute process. Adjustments shall avoid double counting. This proposal is subject to the Seller's approval and execution of definitive documentation.

2. Closing; Conditions; Termination. The parties shall work toward Closing within 30 days after signing definitive documentation, subject to receipt of required regulatory and third-party approvals and satisfaction or waiver by the entitled party of the agreed closing conditions. Buyer shall complete satisfactory due diligence before signing; no separate discretionary post-signing diligence condition is proposed. Closing conditions shall include accuracy of the parties' representations, subject to agreed materiality standards, performance in all material respects of their respective covenants, delivery of agreed closing documents and absence of any legal prohibition on Closing. The definitive agreement shall provide termination rights for mutual written consent, a final nonappealable legal prohibition, failure to close by an agreed outside date, and a material breach causing a closing condition to fail that remains uncured after an agreed notice and cure period. A party whose breach caused the failure to close may not rely on that failure to terminate. Accrued liability for pre-termination breaches and specified surviving obligations shall be preserved.

3. Representations; Interim Covenants; Indemnification. The definitive agreement shall contain customary Seller representations concerning title to the Shares, authority, capitalization, financial statements, undisclosed liabilities, taxes, material contracts, litigation and compliance with applicable law, subject to negotiated scope, materiality and knowledge qualifications and disclosure schedules. Buyer shall provide customary representations concerning authority, enforceability and availability of funds. Between signing and Closing, Seller shall procure that the business operates in the ordinary course, preserves its business relationships and assets in all material respects, and refrains from agreed extraordinary actions without Buyer's prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed, subject to agreed exceptions. Buyer shall receive reasonable diligence access on notice, subject to confidentiality, privilege, applicable law and non-disruption protections. The definitive agreement shall provide customary indemnification for breaches of representations and covenants, with negotiated survival periods, claim procedures, baskets, caps, mitigation requirements, exclusions for duplicate recovery and an exclusive-remedy provision with agreed exceptions, including fraud. An escrow or holdback may secure Seller's indemnification obligations, with its amount, duration, release mechanics and relationship to liability limits to be agreed; no amount or duration is accepted by this draft.

4. Confidentiality. The parties shall keep confidential the terms of the proposed transaction and nonpublic information disclosed in connection with it, subject to any existing confidentiality agreement. Customary exceptions shall apply to information that is publicly available other than through breach, already lawfully known without restriction, independently developed or lawfully obtained from a third party without a confidentiality duty. Disclosure may be made to representatives and financing sources with a need to know who are bound by appropriate confidentiality obligations, or as required by law, regulation or legal process, with advance notice where legally permitted and reasonable cooperation to seek protective treatment. Public announcements require prior written consent except where legally required. Confidentiality obligations shall survive termination for the period agreed in definitive documentation or the existing confidentiality agreement.

receiver.requested_changes: Replace USD 45,000,000 with a proposed USD 36,000,000, subject to Buyer approval, satisfactory pre-signing diligence and definitive documentation. Specify the cash/debt and working-capital methodology, consistent accounting policies, an illustrative calculation, a post-closing true-up and independent-accountant process, without double counting. Require complete disclosure schedules and agreed diligence access before signing. Expand Seller representations to cover ownership of material assets, intellectual property, employment and benefits, data protection, environmental matters and insolvency, as applicable. Include ordinary-course and no-leakage covenants, with Buyer consent for material extraordinary actions. Provide an appropriately defined material-adverse-effect closing condition, an agreed outside date allowing sufficient time for approvals, and no obligation to close before conditions are satisfied or waived. Propose a 10% indemnity escrow for 18 months, general representation survival of 18 months, a 0.5% deductible basket and a 15% general liability cap; fundamental representations, taxes, fraud and specified indemnities should have separately negotiated treatment and not automatically fall within general limitations. Preserve appropriate equitable relief and ensure the exclusive-remedy provision does not bar purchase-price adjustment claims or other agreed exceptions. State expressly that negotiations and draft terms are nonbinding except under any separately binding confidentiality agreement.
receiver.message_back:
Thank you. The expanded framework is a constructive basis for further work. We can proceed on the basis that diligence is completed before signing, provided Buyer receives adequate access and complete disclosure schedules sufficiently in advance; Buyer would not accept an obligation to sign before that work is satisfactorily completed.

The USD 45,000,000 price remains unacceptable. To narrow the gap, we propose USD 36,000,000, subject to Buyer's approval, satisfactory diligence, agreement on the adjustment methodology and execution of definitive documentation. Please obtain Seller's response to that figure or a concrete counterproposal.

Our principal drafting requests are a fully specified cash, debt and working-capital adjustment mechanism; expanded business representations; ordinary-course and no-leakage protections; appropriate closing conditions and termination rights; and meaningful indemnity security. As an opening position on the latter, we propose a 10% escrow for 18 months, 18-month general representation survival, a 0.5% deductible basket and a 15% general cap, with separately negotiated treatment for fundamental representations, taxes, fraud and identified diligence risks. All figures and terms remain proposals, not agreed provisions.

Please also confirm the proposed diligence timetable and provide an initial disclosure-schedule package. The 30-day post-signing closing target must remain subject to required approvals and satisfaction or waiver of agreed conditions. No binding purchase commitment will arise unless definitive documentation is executed.
